name: label
summary: Single- or multi-line static text display. Use for headings, captions, status text, crystal_short hashes overlaid on Sprite3D tiles, debug HUD output. Supports BBCode-free plain text with horizontal/vertical alignment, autowrap, and theme font overrides. For chain_render_wall, Label nodes show category/action/crystal under each rendered tile. Prefer Label over RichTextLabel when no inline formatting is needed (cheaper draw).
example_tscn_snippet:
[node name="MyLabel" type="Label" parent="."]
offset_right = 200.0
offset_bottom = 24.0
text = "crystal: 0e515ed4"
horizontal_alignment = 1
vertical_alignment = 1
